notes: Preparation tracker. Lines are generated by src/build_prep.py (re-run it after final_items.json, the CAD build or hardware/pcb/netlist changes; the C board/cable lines are read from bom.csv, cables.csv and harness.csv at build time, so they follow the 01 circuit tab). It writes fin/prep/lines.json (canonical, 204 KB, fetched on first open for the '자세히' texts), src/tabs/prep/section.html (light copy of the same data inline as <script type=application/json id=prep-data>, ~65 KB, so the summary card and deep links work without a fetch) and this meta.json. Generated 2026-10-31 17:05. Lines: 307 total; main % uses A+B+C = 263 lines. A 부품 100 lines (+2 optional u07, i204), need total 969 (924 개, 18 장, 1 팩, 5 m, 2 쌍, 9 줄, 2 세트, 2 봉, 1 대, 1 가닥, 1 통, 3 롤). B 출력물 104 files = 507 parts in stl/print (+21 optional stl/print_extra files, 47 parts). C 가공·조립 59 lines, need total 1067 (813 개, 18 토막, 176 건반, 31 장, 28 가닥, 1 번). D 공구 21 lines, need 21 (15 개, 6 벌), out of the main % unless the '공구(D)도 전체 준비율에 넣기' box is on. Counts: whole-unit lines floor a typed fraction (1.5 of 2 stays 1, never rounds up to done); the 3 length lines (unit m: a-i023, a-i024, a-i037) carry "dec":1 in lines.json and take one decimal (input step 0.1, inputmode decimal, also floored: 1.95 m -> 1.9 m), compared with need without rounding; +/- buttons move 1 unit. Percent = floor(100 * mean over counted lines of min(ready, need)/need). Persistence: requires capabilities {db:{}, user:{}, downloads:true}; db document 'prep/state' = {counts:{lineId:n}, include:{lineId:true}, opts:{tools:bool}, updatedAt}; first write is set() (document absent), later writes update() with only the changed keys, 600 ms debounce, one write in flight, re-read + back-off on unavailable; user.can('data.write') false or a rejected write -> read-only banner; no db -> localStorage 'toccata.prep.v1' + banner. Saved counts of a line id that no longer exists are ignored (not counted). API: window.toccata.prep = {onChange(cb)->unsubscribe, summary(), line(id), lines()} (+ _test for node tests). Renders a compact card into #sum-prep (summary tab) using global classes .card .eyebrow .num .small .muted and inline token styles only. Element ids: prep-r-<lineId> (row, deep-linkable), prep-in-<lineId> (count input), prep-inc-<lineId> (optional include), prep-g-<group>, prep-sg-<sub>. Line ids: a-<item id> / d-<item id> (final_items), b-<folder>-<sha1(folder/name)[:8]> and bx-<…> (print files), c-<name> (making; boards c-sb, c-mb …, cables c-w101-w107, c-w601 …). CSV export via downloads.save (Toccata_준비체크_YYYY-MM-DD.csv, UTF-8 BOM); without the capability the button is replaced by a note with the file name and size. Row images use img/bom/<id>.jpg from the items step (loading=lazy).
